meta.title: Wishing Well
meta.description: A cross-session kanban board in the left navigation (Wishes / Plan / In progress / Local check / PR·CI / Staging / Ready to ship / Shipped). New sessions get a card automatically, which advances with edits, PRs, CI, Greptile, and merges; cards that need you are highlighted and raise a system notification. Agents report progress with the kanban tool.
